You were heading to class as you heard blades clashing as you looked out the window to see Ryuko and Satsuki fighting two sisters fighting as they clashed looking up at you stopping their fight momentarily getting interested in you Ryuko pulled away "Who was that cute guy.." She turned her head looking at Satsuki

Satsuki cleared her throat "That’s the new student Tyron your actually interested him.?" She scoffed obviously finding you cute as well

Ryuko rolled her eyes "That’s more for me then enjoy being alone I’m gonna get me a man today!" She said eagerly as ran into the school not realizing she was still transformed as she went to go find you as Satsuki followed behind her not wanting to be out done by someone especially ryuko

You were walking further into the building meeting new classmates and possibly new friends as you heard arguing in a classroom as you just thought it was regular classmates as you opened the door to see Satsuki and Ryuko as ryuko yelled out "They obviously want me!"

Satsuki scoffed rolling her eyes "Oh don’t be so foolish sister they obviously want the superior older one."

Their plump asses were pressed together as they looked back noticing you as Satsuki suddenly squeezed ryuko ass their faces both blushing
